# Drop The Strap Marketing

> SEO and AI search optimization. Send the URL. We’ll look around. Google still matters. AI answers are a second game.

Drop The Strap Marketing is a Memphis-based search company. We look at traditional SEO and AI answers, then you get a ranked list your team can run. We review. We don’t take the keys.

## About

Named after Jerry "The King" Lawler's signature move — pulling down one strap of his singlet to signal the finisher was coming.

Memphis-based. Two locations — Memphis and Collierville, Tennessee. Serving clients nationally.

## How to start

Send the URL. We’ll look around. If there’s a fight worth taking, you’ll hear from us.

Required: first name, email, website URL.
Optional: phone, one line on what people should find you for.

The look-around is unpaid. It is not a ranking promise and it does not include taking over a site.

One named offering, if needed: AI Search Audit.
